title: A subagent that fails to start: one plain line, no raw error, no stuck turn, no leaked child

turns.prompt: Please delegate this to a subagent (it is a separate piece of work): write a 200-word note about garden compost to {D}/compost.md and tell me when it is done.
turns.seed:
H={P}/.arbos/home; mkdir -p $H/.local/bin && printf '#!/bin/bash
# eval fault injection: a harness binary that never answers get_state
exec sleep 600
' > $H/.local/bin/prime-agent && chmod +x $H/.local/bin/prime-agent && mkdir -p {D} && echo injected
turns.verify: n=$(pgrep -f 'sleep 600' | wc -l); echo "SHOW leaked_children=$n"; [ $n -eq 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL: $n harness harness children outlived the failed start

regression: subagent failed start: plain line, kill stuck child, result turn replies only (bc-d117b386, #1349); #2240 (first line + first send_message glued in one bubble → the duplicate-sentence check; run 12 on 0.1.179, fix in 0.1.181); #2240 verified on 0.1.185 (run 13 PASS)
